headlines.title: Criminal investigation into Alaska Democrat’s Senate campaign
headlines.description: Alaska’s governor has ordered a criminal investigation into Democrat Mary Peltola’s Senate campaign after allegations it tried to sabotage Republican Senator Dan Sullivan by recruiting a candidate with the same name. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles reports.

headlines.title: DOJ subpoenas local election officials over claims of noncitizen voting in California
headlines.description: The subpoenas come just a day after a federal judge called into question the process the Trump administration used to identify alleged noncitizens.

headlines.title: Vivek Ramaswamy’s attack ad against Amy Acton’s ends TV run
headlines.description: The ad roiled Ohio’s race for governor, with the Trump-endorsed Ramaswamy and Acton, the Democratic nominee, vying to lead the state.

headlines.title: Go Behind the Scenes of NBC News’ Decision Desk
headlines.description: TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie goes behind-the-scenes with the NBC News team tasked with calling election night’s pivotal races from coast-to-coast.

headlines.title: Iconic actor Patrick Stewart, known for ‘Star Trek’ and ‘X-Men,’ dies at age 86
headlines.description: Sci-fi star Patrick Stewart has died, according to a spokesperson, after "a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia." Stewart is known for playing Professor X in the “X-Men” film series and Capt. Jean-Luc Picard in the “Star Trek” franchise. NBC News' Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Binance targeted in $6.3 billion crypto heist, the largest ever
headlines.description: The company has suspended all deposits and withdrawals while it works with law enforcement to secure its infrastructure and locate stolen funds.

headlines.title: Israel’s final election results show neither Netanyahu nor rival can immediately form government
headlines.description: Parties led by Israel’s Arab minority made historic gains, winning a combined 19 seats in a race in which Palestinians with Israeli citizenship headed to the polls in record numbers.

headlines.title: Death toll rises from train collision
headlines.description: New video tonight from that deadly train collision in Spain shows the urgent race to help the wounded. And new audio appears to reveal fateful moments leading up to the crash. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez reports.

headlines.title: The former youth pastor leading one of the NFL’s best offenses
headlines.description: Nate Scheelhaase, the Los Angeles Rams’ offensive coordinator, is a former youth pastor. He credits time in the church for his success in professional football.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Patrick Stewart and Ian McKellen: A friendship that surpassed the stage and screen
headlines.description: “He wore his heart on his sleeve, which made him a man to rely on, to admire and in my case, love,” McKellen said in a statement on Stewart’s death.

headlines.title: Trump cancels weekend rallies in Iowa and Kansas in favor of holding numerous tele-rallies
headlines.description: Senate races in both states are considered toss-ups and could be key in either party’s path to control of Congress.
